ui.theme_switch_aria: Switch between light and dark theme
ui.upload_subtitle: Upload the purchase order, goods receipt and purchase invoice. The application compares the documents at header and line level and reports — per line — whether they match, warn or fail.
ui.doc_po_desc: The order as issued by procurement (PO).
ui.doc_grn_desc: Packing slip or receipt confirmation from the warehouse.
ui.doc_inv_desc: The invoice received from the supplier.
ui.tol_price_hint_html: Max. deviation on unit price between PO and invoice.
ui.tol_qty_hint_html: Max. deviation on quantity between PO, GRN and invoice.
ui.tol_line_total_hint_html: Max. deviation on line amount between PO and invoice.
ui.tol_total_hint_html: Max. deviation on grand total between PO and invoice.
ui.formats_text_html: CSV and JSON. Column names are flexible — quantity/qty, unit_price/price, line_total/amount are all recognised. See the sample files for the exact structure.
ui.error_tolerance: Tolerances must be numbers between 0 and {max}.
ui.error_file_type: '{name}' is not a CSV or JSON file (received type: {type}).
ui.error_request_too_large: The upload is too large. At most {max_mb} MB per file.
ui.footer_ai_on: Note: "Run match" sends the parsed PO, goods receipt and invoice data to the Google Gemini API for an advisory AI review. The verdict itself remains the rule-based match with your tolerances.
ui.footer_ai_off: AI is off on this server: files are processed only here, not stored and not sent to any external service.
ui.footer_sent: For the AI review, the parsed PO, goods receipt and invoice data and the match result were sent to {provider} (model {model}).
ui.footer_not_sent: No data was sent to an external AI service.
ui.ai_status_rejected: The AI answer was rejected and is not shown:
ui.ai_status_unavailable: The AI service gave no usable answer:
ui.ai_status_disabled: AI is off on this server:
ui.ai_independent_note: The verdict above is the rule-based match with your tolerances and does not depend on the AI.
ui.audit_trail_note: Contains SHA-256 hashes of the input files, the match result, the AI status and (when validated) the AI recommendations, for re-performance.

msg.po_missing_number: PO does not contain a purchase order number.
msg.po_ref_grn_differs: PO reference on goods receipt differs: '{grn_po}' vs PO '{po_num}'.
msg.po_ref_inv_differs: PO reference on invoice differs: '{inv_po}' vs PO '{po_num}'.
msg.supplier_inconsistent: Supplier name is not consistent across documents: {names}.
msg.line_missing_po: Line missing on the purchase order.
msg.line_missing_grn: Line missing on the goods receipt.
msg.qty_billed_vs_po: Invoiced quantity differs from PO: {inv_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_received_more_po: Received quantity greater than ordered: {grn_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_received_less_po: Received quantity less than ordered: {grn_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_billed_vs_grn: Invoiced quantity greater than received: {inv_qty} vs {grn_qty}.
msg.missing_total: {doc} has no document total and no line totals.
msg.total_vs_lines: {doc}: stated total {total} differs from the sum of the lines {lines_sum}.
msg.value_missing: {doc}: {field} is missing or not a valid number.
msg.line_arithmetic: {doc}: quantity × unit price ({qty} × {price} = {expected}) does not equal the line total {total}.
msg.dup_price_differs: {doc}: item appears on several lines with different unit prices: {prices}.
